name: art-abstract
purpose: Draw an abstract picture as dark and light SVG in the design tokens' colours (board, blueprint or paper): orbits, drifting ribbons, a tile grid or a burst, still or looping.
examples: abstract art for my header in the board look
a looping generative pattern as an svg

out.description: the file stem: STEM-dark.svg and STEM-light.svg are written

title.description: what a screen reader says the picture is

style.description: the design tokens the colours come from

composition.description: orbits: rings round a focus; drift: ribbons and motes; grid: a tile weave; burst: rays from a core

density.description: how many rings, ribbons (at most 6 are drawn), tiles across or ray groups

accent.description: the first of the six accent colours; the next two follow it

seed.description: another seed draws another picture from the same slots

motion.description: one loop's length as a CSS duration, or none for a still picture
